froguitar.name: Froguitar
froguitar.desc: The frog with the six-string. Gains +10% damage every 10 levels (max +50%).

drumadillo.name: Drumadillo
drumadillo.desc: Rolls with the punches. +1 armor, tougher, a little slow.

violynx.name: Violynx
violynx.desc: First chair, light on her feet. +20% move speed, +10% projectile speed, less HP.

bassbear.name: Bass Bear
bassbear.desc: Holds down the low end. +15% area, lots of HP, plays 10% slower.

pianowl.name: Pianowl
pianowl.desc: Studied for years. +15% experience, and +1% more every level up to +30%.

trumpelephant.name: Trumpelephant
trumpelephant.desc: Never forgets a fanfare. +20% damage, -10% move speed.

synthfox.name: Synth Fox
synthfox.desc: Always twiddling knobs. Plays 8% faster, +15% duration.

choircrow.name: Choir Crow
choircrow.desc: A murder of one. Recovers 0.3 HP per second, +10% area.

djgecko.name: DJ Gecko
djgecko.desc: Paid by the hour. +30% gold, and +1 projectile from level 20.

lofisloth.name: Lo-Fi Sloth
lofisloth.desc: In no hurry at all. -25% move speed, plays 15% faster, +20% duration.

mime.name: The Mime
mime.desc: Plays the instrument you cannot touch. +30% damage, +20% curse, fragile.
